title: Han Solo's Landspeeder
description: As a young scrumrat on Corellia, Han Solo boosted an overpowered Mobquet M-68 landspeeder under questionable circumstances that he'd rather not explain. Fast and maneuverable, the M-68 was a favorite among the speed enthusiasts of Corellia due to its repulsorlift generator that was easily modified and overcharged. When Han drove the landspeeder at top speed trying to escape the White Worms after he double-crossed them, he dangled his lucky charm in the windshield—a pair of chance cubes used for playing sabacc.
